title: Automatic per-repo GitHub account selection for the gh CLI
smallest_useful_product: A Go gh shim that matches cwd and git remote rules, gets the selected user's token from gh, and execs gh with GH_TOKEN scoped to the child process. Includes init and which commands.
constraints: Never mutate gh global authentication state
Support GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise hosts
Deprecate gracefully if gh gains native contextual switching
